styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, soft blush pink #FBEDEF for benefit and detail screens, one deep blush panel #F3E2E8 for macro

styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet premium childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft blush pink #FBEDEF, charcoal text #3A3A3C and one magenta accent #E0218A; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示完整廓形
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, straight-on eye-level, garment on an invisible form, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow at the hem
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment shown on an invisible form at a slight 3/4 hero angle, straight-on eye-level, full silhouette visible with sleeves relaxed. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the hem. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial childrenswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no child model, no recognizable face, no hanger hardware, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no cut-off edges.

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on front view with the garment occupying the left half at 50-60% of the frame, soft blush pink background #FBEDEF, soft front-left key light with a gentle highlight sweeping across the wool surface, soft contact shadow. provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1 主图外景人像（呢子外套+礼帽+绿植背景+泡泡道具）；屏2 三色多图拼版（玫红/正红/浅粉三色外套）；屏3 前后版型对照加翻领局部标注；屏4 翻领/袖口/下摆三处细节编号标注加外景人像；屏5 面料绒面大图与洗护提示行；屏6 产品信息参数区（颜色玫红、尺码110-160）与多指数条；屏7 尺码表（肩宽/衣长/袖长/胸围列，110-150码）加年龄体重参照表与模特展示开篇；屏8 上身正面特写与外景人像；屏9 正面与背影双图收尾。品类判定依据：硬证据为尺码 110-160 身高段、年龄参照表 3-14 岁、成衣为外穿中长呢大衣，属外穿童装而非贴身儿童内衣，故 L1=母婴 L2=童装，与源夹名一致。已剥离内容：原品牌字母水印与系列字样、可辨识童模面容（改为颈部以下裁切与背影）、原文案原句、面料功效性说法（抗起球/抗皱等一律改占位）、尺码表实测数值（改空白表格单元）、洗护图标组、促销角标与购物按钮字样；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
